text: Manage your mental state through breathing. In any stressful situation, use breathing as a remote control for the nervous system. Try it—take a slow, deep inhale for 4 counts and an even slower exhale for 8 counts. Just 3–5 such breathing cycles relieve affect, activate the parasympathetic nervous system, fill you with calm and confidence, and restore clarity of mind. Switching attention from the external to the internal—that is, into the body—helps strengthen this technique. For example, to the sensation of air passing through the nostrils into the lungs, or to the breathing of ajna (this is already pranayama). And also (for future growth) try with your “inner ear” to listen to the beats of your pulse, and count exactly them.
